findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: checkout_session, get_profile, track_order, start_return · Public sink: report_problem, get_profile, track_order, start_return · Destructive: find_products, add_to_basket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: checkout_session, get_profile, track_order, start_return · Public sink: report_problem, get_profile, track_order, start_return · Destructive: find_products, add_to_basket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
